summary: # ** CENTRAL ELECTRICITY REGULATORY COMMISSION NEW DELHI ** # ** No. L-1/44/2010-CERC ** **Coram:** **Shri P. K. Pujari, Chairperson Dr. M.K. Iyer, Member Shri I.S. Jha, Member** ** Date of Order: 4 ** **th** ** of February, 2019 ** # ** In the matter of ** Approval of slab rates for POC Charges and losses for the period January to March 2016, under the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Sharing of Inter State Transmission Charges and Losses) Regulations, 2010 and amendments thereto. ** And ** **In the matter of** National Load Dispatch Centre . Respondent # ** CORRIGENDUM ** The Central Electricity Regulatory Commission had issued order dated 12.03.2016 approving slab rates for PoC Charges towards ‘LTA/MTOA and STOA’, Reliability Support Charge Rate, HVDC Charge Rate as well as slabs for PoC losses for the Application Period January to March 2016. 2. NLDC vide its letter dated 24.04.2017 had submitted that LTA demand data of Odisha for the period Jan'16 to Mar'16 was inadvertently considered as 1035 MW instead of 1223 MW, while determining the PoC Slab Rates and accordingly has submitted the revised PoC Slab Rates for the said period. 3. Further, GRIDCO has filed Petition No 313/MP/2018 on 20.08.2018 at CERC for re-determination of slab Rates for Quarter Q4 of FY 2015-16 determined vide CERC **Corrigendum Slab rates for PoC Charges & Losses for Jan-Mar 2016** Page 1 Order dated 12.03.2016 bringing out the above said error to notice of the Commission. 4. It is further noticed that the error has occurred in LTA of Odisha which was taken as 1,035 MW in place of 1,223 MW and that of Bihar which was taken as 2,623 MW in place of 2,435 MW in calculation of PoC Slab Rates for January to March 2016. 5. The PoC rates for LTA/MTOA have been revised considering correct LTA data for Odisha and Bihar as 1223 MW and 2435 MW respectively. Accordingly, the revised Annexure- I of the order dated 12.03.2016 with revised PoC slabs rates have been annexed to this order. There shall be no change in HVDC rates and reliability rates due to this correction since the share of LTA among Odisha and Bihar have been revised but the overall LTA remains same.
